experiments.study_type: Induction of acute cholestasis by common bile duct ligation
experiments.procedure_text: The bile duct was isolated and a 7-0 silk ligature was tied at proximal and distal end to the liver hilus, followed by resection between the two ligatures.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: The bile duct was isolated from the surrounding tissues, and a 7-0 silk ligature was tied at proximal and distal end to the liver hilus. Finally, the bile duct was resected between the two ligatures.
experiments.test_system_evidence: Male C57BL/6, aged 10-12 weeks, GF (germ-free) and ASF (altered Schaedler's flora) mice
experiments.route_evidence: the mice received 60 μg/ kg body weight of buprenorphine subcutaneously

endpoints.label: quantification of bile infarcts
endpoints.evidence: quantification of bile infarcts as well as Sirius red staining for determination of fibrotic tissue

endpoints.label: fibrotic tissue
endpoints.evidence: Sirius red staining for determination of fibrotic tissue in the liver

endpoints.label: mRNA sequencing
endpoints.evidence: Total RNA concentration of 1-2 μg was used for mRNA sequencing

endpoints.label: total-free fatty acids
endpoints.evidence: total-free fatty acids were measured in 10 mg of liver tissue

endpoints.label: oxygen consumption rates
endpoints.evidence: The oxygen consumption rates (OCRs) in homogenates from frozen livers were measured

substances.name: buprenorphine
substances.evidence: the mice received 60 μg/ kg body weight of buprenorphine subcutaneously

experiments.exposure_evidence: mice received 60 μg/ kg body weight of buprenorphine subcutaneously (Reckitt Benckiser, 0.3 mg/ml) before the surgery.
experiments.notes: Experiment utilized both germ-free (GF) and altered Schaedler's flora (ASF) mice.
